ValidationRule.description: FB-910. QuoteAccountId is stamped from the Opportunity Account at Quote creation and drives the BAN and Contact lookup filters. A later Account change strands those Quotes.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Account cannot be changed once the Opportunity has moved past 2-Prospect. Quotes, BANs and Contacts are already tied to this Account. If the Account is wrong, close this Opportunity and raise a new one.
